description: Events of a single Bittensor Subtensor block by block number: event count, block hash, parent hash, and raw SCALE-encoded System.Events bytes. Returns 404 for a block that does not exist yet. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_block_metrics when you need Per-block extrinsic and event counts for the last N blocks; crypto_subtensor_events when you need Recent Subtensor chain events, optionally filtered. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
